source.boundary_rule: all 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 labelled row-column minors of the five-by-five Cayley-Menger matrix

cycle_basis.normalization: source-oriented Cayley-Menger chamber fundamental relative-cycle class before the mu2 trace
cycle_basis.measure_branch: continued from the frozen source branch on a disk containing the puncture

result: No source boundary minor or measure branch degenerates at either finite coefficient puncture on the generic exceptional locus. The labelled relative pair extends across each puncture, so the source chamber class has trivial local Betti monodromy before the mu2 trace.
qualification: The statement is generic away from the t-independent exceptional discriminant and soft support. It does not determine coefficient monodromy or prove invariance of the combined pairing.
